create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal structure with a specified number of atoms using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal supercell with a specified number of unit cells using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells
create_water_box: create a random box of water molecules with specified count and box size using get_water_box
create_slab_adsorbate: create a slab plus adsorbate system with OC20-style tags and FixAtoms constraints using get_slab_adsorbate
summarize_common_structures: summarize the common_structures module functions for generating FCC crystals, water boxes, and slab adsorbate systems
